title: Time's Hidden Gap
hook: Tyrannosaurus rex is closer to you
script: Tyrannosaurus rex is closer to you What if a T. rex met a Stegosaurus? Stegosaurus lived around 155 million years ago The time gap between them is roughly the same as from the first flowers to now Tyrannosaurus rex lived 66 million years ago, and if Earth's history were a 24-hour clock, T. rex would have lived at 11:55 PM
